title: Layer 2 scaling solutions see unprecedented adoption rates
content:
Is Unprecedented Layer 2 Adoption Stress-Testing Bitcoin's Foundation?

TL;DR: Bitcoin's Layer 2 solutions are seeing surging adoption, offloading transactional pressure from the base layer while the network's foundational security, anchored by a 906.27 EH/s hashrate and 146.47 T difficulty, remains unyielding. This strategic offloading allows Bitcoin to scale globally without compromising its core principles of decentralization and censorship
